column4: Pixel-art overlay exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background filling the whole upper part and middle of the frame, no text. ONLY two hands and one guitar string, nothing else: the same man's dead grey skin and the same red and black checked flannel cuffs as in the reference, from the lower left corner and from the lower right corner two grey hands with long cracked dirty nails grip the two ends of one thin steel guitar string wound round their knuckles and pull it tight straight across the lower part of the frame, toward whoever looks out of this picture, the string pressing a thin dark red line, the knuckles white with the strain, a few drops of dark blood on the string. The hands enter from the bottom corners, the wrists cut off at the edges; the upper part and the middle of the frame stay empty magenta. Horror game first-person overlay, disgusting, not sexual.
